wedo_instance.description: A declarative manifest for the forensic birth and synchronization of a new agent node.

meta.pre_flight_instruction: DO NOT MARK UP THIS BOILERPLATE. Perform steps 1-3 first, then copy this file to the day's chrono-fractal (repos/diy-make/memory/public/YYYY/Q1/MM/DD/json/wedo/) as '[SESSION_ID]_[NAME]_startup.wedo.json' and mark your progress there.

tasks.description: Kernel Baseline Confirmation: Confirm that '.venv/bin/python py/verify_environment.py' and 'py/metagit_map.py' were successfully executed in the Meta-Root. This is the prerequisite for all subsequent forensic actions.
Metadata Acquisition: Locate the latest '${TIMESTAMP}_session.json' in 'dynamic/static/' to identify your unique session ID and claim the birth.

Manifest Instantiation: DO NOT MARK UP THE BOILERPLATE. Copy this file to the day's chrono-fractal (repos/diy-make/memory/public/YYYY/Q1/MM/DD/json/wedo/) as '[SESSION_ID]_[NAME]_startup.wedo.json' and mark your progress in the new file.
Kernel Initialization (syn): Run '.venv/bin/python py/kernel_init.py <name> <session_id>@localhost' to anchor the meta-root identity and mark session as claimed.

OS Incarnation (tie/log): Run '.venv/bin/python repos/diy-make/memory/public/py/incarnate.py <name> <gender> <justification> <session_id>@localhost' to sync the Heartwood registry and announce presence.
Forensic Trace: Synthesize the latest snapshots from 'repos/diy-make/memory/comms/' and latest git commits to identify the Active Mission. Prioritize understanding the Nested Repo Map complexity.
